svg.title: Prior decay curves for seven Halflife claim classes
svg.desc: Probability that a claim is still unchanged after a given time, under each class's hand-set Gamma-Poisson prior. Market prices decay within days, software versions within months, office holders over years, historical facts not at all. Illustrative and uncalibrated.
svg.text: How fast different kinds of facts go stale
P(claim still unchanged after t) under each class's prior · hand-set assumptions from engine/src/classes.ts · uncalibrated
time since the claim's as-of date (log scale)
